If CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset, APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED is falsy and the handler returns 403 before reaching the header comparison. And if the secret is set but the header is absent, `undefined !== process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` also fails, returning 403. The only edge case (both empty string "") is also blocked because "" is falsy for the sharing-enabled check. Thu

adjudication.rationale: The handler immediately blocks all requests when credential sharing is not enabled: `if (!APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED) return 403` (apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts). `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is defined as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` (packages/lib/constants.ts), so if `CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is unset, the endpoint returns 403 before the header comparison. Therefore the alleged `undefined === undefined` bypass when the secret is unset is not reachable per the diff.
